prd.title: Autonomous Improvement Loop v1: Oracle-Driven Quality Iteration
prd.target: Enable autonomous iteration on audiobook analysis using Claude as quality oracle

executive_summary: Implement an autonomous improvement loop that runs the audiobook analysis tool against test texts, evaluates output quality using Claude as an oracle, and iteratively fixes issues until quality thresholds are met. This 'Ralph Wiggum' style loop uses fresh context per iteration with state persisted to disk, allowing systematic quality improvement across multiple test texts without human intervention.

whats_improved: Agent infrastructure with self-verification (STRUCTURAL, SELF_CHECK levels) already exists
Confidence scoring system tracks HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW per item
Test texts available in Test_Texts/ directory
CLI supports full analysis with HTML output

current_failures.example: Human must review HTML output to identify character merge issues, summary hallucinations, etc.
current_failures.root_cause: ORACLE verification level defined but not implemented
current_failures.impact: Quality improvements require human time and attention

current_failures.example: Fixing character extraction for Gatsby may break Frankenstein handling
current_failures.impact: Fixes may introduce new problems undetected

current_failures.example: Long analysis sessions exhaust context window
current_failures.root_cause: No mechanism to reset context while preserving progress

features.name: Oracle Loop Shell Script
features.rationale: Core orchestrator that manages the three-phase iteration cycle with fresh context per phase
features.current_behavior: No automated loop exists - all analysis and evaluation is manual
features.proposed_behavior: Bash script orchestrates ANALYZE -> EVALUATE -> FIX cycle, auto-detecting current phase from state file, respecting quality thresholds and attempt limits

steps: Create EVALUATION_STATE.md with phase: awaiting_analysis
Run ./oracle-loop.sh
Verify it selects PROMPT_analyze.md
Update state to phase: awaiting_evaluation
Run ./oracle-loop.sh again
Verify it selects PROMPT_evaluate.md

user_stories.description: Loop respects max attempts per text
steps: Set max_attempts_per_text: 3 in manifest.json
Run loop until text reaches 3 attempts without passing
Verify loop marks text complete (even if failed) and advances
Check manifest.json shows attempts: 3

user_stories.description: Loop stops when all texts complete
steps: Create manifest with 2 texts
Run loop until both pass quality threshold
Verify loop exits with ALL_COMPLETE message
Check both texts show complete: true in manifest

changes.description: Three-phase loop with Claude Code invocations
